subject: Post-call: Align on demo + schedule dedicated capacity sizing call
messages:
From: Sergio Álvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Morgan <alyssa.morgan@novacorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Align on demo + schedule dedicated capacity sizing call

Hi Alyssa — really appreciated the time earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: We heard that Novacorp plans to ship an LLM-powered assistant in Q4 to handle claims triage (~35k requests/day expected at launch, spiking to ~120k/day during end-of-month processing). Latency target is p95 < 300ms for short-turn responses (<=256 tokens), and you want dedicated capacity for PCI-adjacent traffic.
- What we propose: 1) A short hosted demo for product stakeholders (45 min) to validate UX and integration approach; 2) A dedicated capacity sizing technical deep dive (60–90 min) with your infra team to capture throughput, burst patterns, and KV-cache expectations so we can recommend pool size and autoscale policy.

Availability: Do any of these windows work for the dedicated sizing deep dive?
- Tue 16 Apr 10:00–12:00 PT
- Wed 17 Apr 13:00–16:00 PT
- Thu 18 Apr 09:00–11:00 PT

Prep ask (minimal): If you can share a simple load profile (samples per minute over an 8-hour window, plus any monthly spike multipliers) and a rough seq-length distribution, we’ll pre-run cost/latency simulations. I attached a two-line capacity-template.csv that makes it quick to fill. Also attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we can align stakeholders before the sizing call.

If those windows don't work, send a couple options and we’ll adapt. I’ll bring Laura (platform solutions) and Ben (inference lead) to the sizing call.

Thanks — talk soon.

Sergio Álvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: capacity-template.csv (csv), mutual-action-plan.pdf (pdf)

From: Alyssa Morgan <alyssa.morgan@novacorp.com>
To: Sergio Álvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Kevin Cho <kevin.cho@novacorp.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Align on demo + schedule dedicated capacity sizing call

Thanks Sergio — great recap and thanks for the MAP. We’re keen to move forward.

Quick notes on the load profile: our initial pilot will be for the claims-triage assistant across two regions. Expected baseline ~30–40k reqs/day; heavy processing windows typically last 2–3 hours at month-end with peaks ~4x baseline. Typical prompt/response sizes skew short (most <128 tokens) but we have a 5–7% tail that goes to ~512 tokens. There are also a handful of enterprise customers where we’ll need stronger data isolation (those would be on dedicated pools).

Available windows: Wed 17 Apr 14:00–15:30 PT works for the deep dive (we’ll have our infra and security reps on the call). For the product demo, Tue 16 Apr 11:00 PT preferred.

I’ve attached a quick internal export from our traffic collector (redacted) — let me know if that’s enough. If you need more granularity we can pull a longer window.

Alyssa
Senior Product Manager, Novacorp
alyssa.morgan@novacorp.com

Attachment referenced: novacorp-sample-load.csv (redacted)

Perfect — thanks for the details, Alyssa. Wed 17 Apr 14:00–15:30 PT is confirmed for the dedicated sizing deep dive. I’ll calendar an invite and include an agenda:

Agenda (60–75 min):
- 5–10 min: introductions + goals for the call
- 15–20 min: Novacorp throughput and spike patterns (you lead)
- 20–25 min: Redwood sizing walkthrough (model variants, quantization tradeoffs, KV-cache expectations, recommended pool sizing)
- 10–15 min: Rollout plan and MAP alignment (A/B vs canary vs full cutover)
- 5 min: next steps and owners

Prep I’ll do on our side: pre-run a quick simulation against the sample you attached and share a short runbook with recommended pool config options (gpu counts, autoscale thresholds, estimated tokens/sec, and cost range). I’ve also added links to a one-page prep doc and the MAP in the calendar invite.

Invites: I’m sending invites now to Alyssa, Kevin, Laura, and Ben. If there are additional engineers from your end who should join, reply-all with names.

Thanks — see you on the 17th.

— Sergio
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments included in calendar invite: capacity-template.csv, mutual-action-plan.pdf
